histamine.note: A safe breakfast for histamine-sensitive people.

nutrition.highlight: the beta-glucan is what makes porridge thick

effects.note: A review pooling 22 controlled feeding trials found whole-grain oats and oat bran more reliably increased fullness than other grain foods lower in fibre or viscosity, and a trial comparing isocaloric breakfasts found instant oatmeal beat a ready-to-eat oat cereal on fullness and reduced desire to eat over the next four hours — credited to the gel-forming viscosity of oats' beta-glucan fibre slowing digestion. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
